source: Idaho Department of Health and Welfare, Division of Public Health, Bureau of Vital Records and Health Statistics: Idaho Vital Statistics Annual Reports 2006-2013 ('Selected Causes of Deaths' by county) and Idaho Mortality annual reports 2014-2024 ('Selected Causes of Deaths' 2014-2015; 'Leading Causes of Mortality' and 'Accidental (Unintentional Injury) Mortality by Type of Accident' 2016-2024)
note: Idaho residents by county of residence (44 counties), read 2026-10-15 from the Idaho Department of Health and Welfare's public document portal (Laserfiche WebLink) in the owner's Chrome, using the text layer of the portal's own PDF viewer (pdf.js); no file was downloaded and no request was scripted outside the browser (the portal's firewall rejects scripted requests). Reports and pages (WebLink document id: page): Idaho Vital Statistics Annual Report 2006 (11634: 95-96), 2007 (11632: 93-94), 2008 (11633: 97-98), 2009 (11630: 98-99), 2010 (22957: 106-107), 2011 (11625: 106-107), 2012 (11627: 106-107), 2013 (11628: 105-106), 'Selected Causes of Deaths'; Idaho Mortality 2014 (11611: 20-21), 2015 (11612: 27-28), 'Selected Causes of Deaths'; Idaho Mortality 2016 (11606: 25-26, 44), 2017 (11608: 26-27, 46), 2018 (11609: 27-28, 47), 2019 (15157: 29-30, 49), 2020 (21110: 29-30, 49), 2021 (25158: 29-30, 49), 2022 (28439: 29-30, 49), 2023 (33859: 29-30, 48), 2024 (35625: 29-30, 49), 'Leading Causes of Mortality' and 'Accidental (Unintentional Injury) Mortality by Type of Accident'. The table text was carried to the cloud session as two extracts checked against SHA-256 digests computed in the page per report (all 19 matched): sources/id_dhw/id_dhw_extract_part1.txt (SHA-256 bb921eea3c13a429183607cc280a05ebade5dcd53a29bba23b81f285e08230bb) and part2 (10ccc03dfcd155e952dcf08935a743a3238f83643c1c0fe8ebcb6f4d71172fbc); scripts/id_build.py maps each table's columns by its printed headings (the column order changes between years). Every cell is an exact count; '-' is zero (stored as 0); no small-number suppression (counts of 1 are printed). Checks: in all 47 tables the 44 county rows add exactly to the seven public-health-district rows and to the state row, except 2022-2024 where the state row is marked with an asterisk and is 1-3 higher (residents whose county is unknown). Causes kept for the map: all deaths, cancer, heart, stroke, CLRD, Alzheimer's, diabetes, flu and pneumonia (2006-2019), kidney (2006-2013, 2015-2016), liver, suicide, homicide (2006-2015), COVID-19 (2020-2023), falls (unintentional, 2016-2024). Kept raw (no map measure): accidents and their subtypes, motor vehicle, unintentional drug poisoning ('Drugs', 2017-2024; not CDC's all-intent overdose), Parkinson's, HIV, hypertension, nutritional deficiencies. Terms: no copyright, permission or reuse wording in the reports; each gives a suggested citation (Idaho Vital Statistics <year>, Idaho Department of Health and Welfare, Division of Public Health, Bureau of Vital Records and Health Statistics). none_stated, cite the Bureau.
